title: Feeder environment
description: Published on <prefix>/environment every telemetry.environment_interval_s, from the SHT4x. New in this firmware; the predecessor had no environmental sensor.

ts.description: Epoch milliseconds, or 0 when the clock has not been set

humidity_pct.description: Cropped to 0-100 as the datasheet prescribes. The conversion can yield values just outside that range; publishing 100.4 %RH would let a consumer graph a rounding artefact as weather.
